description: This file defines the interface for internal server-side media pipeline operations within the Rialto project. It includes class declarations for the factory and the internal media pipeline interface, which provides methods for media data management and playback control, intended for implementation by the Rialto server.

classes.name: IMediaPipelineServerInternalFactory
classes.description: Factory class for creating instances of IMediaPipelineServerInternal, providing a static method to instantiate the factory and a method to create media pipeline instances.

classes.name: IMediaPipelineServerInternal
classes.description: Interface for internal server media pipeline operations, including method to notify the server of media data availability.

methods.name: createFactory
methods.description: Static method to create an instance of the factory for internal media pipeline.

methods.name: createMediaPipelineServerInternal
methods.description: Creates a new internal media pipeline instance with specified client, video requirements, session ID, shared memory buffer, and decryption service.

methods.name: haveData
methods.description: Method to notify the server that media data is available, with status, number of frames, and request ID.
